Exercises


               1.1    How much  can you guess about the meaning  of these idioms just by looking at the
                     context? Tick the boxes according to what you can understand about the words in
                     bold.
                     1  | decided | was going to get a place at university by hook or by crook. It had always
                        been my dream  to study for a degree in history.
                                                                              DON’T KNOW/
                                                                YES    NO      CAN’T TELL
                        means  using illegal methods if necessary
                        means  nothing will stop me                    LJ
                        means  | was very determined            CJ     C]                    See Unit 18.
                     2  The government and the unions are at loggerheads; there may be a general strike.
                                                                              DON’T KNOW/
                                                                YES    NO      CAN’T TELL
                        means  have a good relationship         LJ     C]
                        means  hate each other                  L]     L]
                        means disagree very strongly            C]     LJ         C          See Unit 22.
                     3  We had to pay through the nose to get our visas in five days instead of the usual 30 days.
                                                                               DON’T KNOW/
                                                                YES    NO      CAN’T TELL
                        means  suffer in some way                                 (J
                        means  pay a small sum of money                C)         CJ
                        means  pay a large sum of money         CJ     CJ                    See Unit 24.

                     Correct the mistakes in the idioms in these sentences. Use the clues in brackets. Use a
                     good  general dictionary or a dictionary of idioms if necessary.
      | Cambridge
        Dictionary    1 My father’s foot was put down when | said | wanted a car for my seventeenth birthday.
                        He said | was too young. (grammar - voice)                           See Unit 48.
